name: side-panel

frames.best_why: Panel is fully open, showing the nav list and both recently viewed image cards.

tagline: A small menu tab unfurls into a wide panel of links and cards.
summary: A compact dark tab at the top left opens sideways into a broad rounded panel. Inside, a four-item nav list sits beside two recently viewed image cards, and it folds back to a tab on a second click.
appearance: A dark rounded tab sits at the top left of a dashboard, holding a menu icon and the word Menu. When open the tab grows into a wide rounded panel with a labelled nav column on the left and two photo cards on the right.
behaviour: Clicking the tab slides the panel open across almost the full width, measuring its contents so the height springs to fit. Clicking again folds it back to the small tab while the inner content fades away.
demo_content: Today at Northwind dashboard with revenue metrics and two recently viewed cards.
search_phrases: expanding menu panel from a tab
wide menu with links and thumbnails
top left menu that opens wide
slide out navigation for a dashboard
menu button that reveals a panel
use_when: A dashboard needs a simple global menu that opens over the page without a route change.
avoid_when: It opens almost full width and relies on the app sitting behind it, so it needs a wide screen.
customise: Open state and the toggle handler are required props; a render prop supplies the trigger button and the panel body is children.
weight_why: A measured spring on width and height; nothing loops once the panel settles.

a11y.note: The panel adds no aria-expanded or dialog role of its own, leaving announcement to the supplied trigger.

issues: The demo trigger removes its focus outline, so keyboard focus is invisible.
The shell has no aria-expanded, so the open state is not announced.
polish_why: Smooth width and height springs with a tidy two-column layout; the trigger drops its focus ring.
title: Side Panel
